trace_summary.task_objective: Retrieve every Wikipedia abstract required to verify the claim: Gabriel Iglesias, an Greek comedian, actor, writer, producer and voice actor from "Hot & Fluffy" voices a character in the first film produced by Gulfstream Pictures.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The system returned 24 documents (with duplicates) including abstracts for Gabriel Iglesias, Gulfstream Pictures, The Nut Job, Hot and Fluffy, and related entities. The documents contain all information needed to verify the claim: Gabriel Iglesias is American (not Greek), is associated with Hot & Fluffy, and voices a character in The Nut Job, which is Gulfstream Pictures' first film.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline successfully retrieved all Wikipedia abstracts needed to verify the claim. Hop 1 retrieved Gabriel Iglesias and Gulfstream Pictures abstracts. The summarizer correctly identified that the claim contains a factual error (Greek vs American) and noted missing evidence about Iglesias voicing in Gulfstream's first film. Hop 2 successfully retrieved The Nut Job abstract confirming Iglesias voices in it. Hop 3 retrieved Hot and Fluffy abstract confirming the show reference. All required entities were retrieved: Gabriel Iglesias (with nationality and Hot & Fluffy connection), Gulfstream Pictures (with first film identification), The Nut Job (with voice cast including Iglesias), and Hot and Fluffy (confirming the show). The system correctly did not emit a verdict, as designed. The task objective was fully met.
